content:
leah: quick follow-up from the RFC review earlier — we need a concrete cutover playbook for the local control-plane option. thinking a staged rollout with feature flag and auto-fallback.
prashant: agree. we should enumerate failure modes first: cert rotation lag, ip exhaustion for ENIs, latency regressions for cold tenants.
maria: also consider identity propagation: if we terminate mtls at the relay versus tenant cp it changes our threat model and ops steps.
kevin: +1. operationally the biggest pain will be maintaining stable egress IPs for customers using allowlists. what's our plan there?
leah: proposal: 1) keep global egress as fallback for allowlisted customers, 2) for tenants opting into local cp, allocate ephemeral EIP pool per-region with auto-rotate policy we control. if a tenant needs sticky ips, they stay on global.
prashant: how do we detect/control ip exhaustion? metrics and a preflight that checks available ENI/EIP quota before enabling local cp per-tenant. if quota low, fail the flag.
maria: ops runbook: when cert rotation stalls, we shift traffic via global cp relay for affected tenant for N minutes and retry rotation. need a runbook snippet: `curl -X POST https://ops/reroute -d '{"tenant":"...","target":"global"}'`
kevin: can we automate that in the operator? a controller that watches cert age + fail counts and flips routing label. manual only as last resort.
leah: yes — operator can be optimistic: attempt rotation 3x, then flip label + emit alert. also add a canary window: enable local cp for 1% tenants first, monitor latency/p99 and error budget.
adarsh: rollout stages: DEV preview (internal tenants) -> 1% prod canary -> 25% region -> full region. each stage gated by: p99 latency delta < 10ms, error budget usage < 1%, egress-ip-saturation < 80%.
prashant: migration path: we need a one-click revert per-tenant in console and an automated rollback policy based on realtime metrics. also preserve request tracing across relay <-> local so traces remain linked.
maria: on certs: prefer short-lived certs minted by control-plane CA; rotation performed by tenant-agent with proof-of-work handshake. tricky bit: clock skew during bootstrapping — add jitter and backoff.
kevin: cost question: more ENIs and NAT gateways per-tenant increases cost. include a cost-visibility dashboard per-tenant and an opt-in premium tier for sticky ip/local cp.
leah: ops checklist for cutover day: preflight quota check, enable feature flag for canary cohort, monitor 5 dashboards (latency, errors, cert-rotate, eip-usage, tracing continuity), escalation contact list. if anything crosses threshold: flip affected tenants to global via operator.
ops-bot: deploybot: rollout trigger accepted for feature flag `local_cp` -> cohort A (internal). :rocket:
adarsh: small note — document rollback window (15m) and retention for logs during cutover (increase to 48h). saves debugging.
prashant: I'll draft the runbook snippets and operator spec. leah, can you add the gating thresholds to the RFC?
leah: will do. thanks team. tagging follow-up action owners in the RFC doc. :thumbsup:
